uncited: Hash Encoding is independent per GPU, confined within a non-overlapping bounding box.
Color MLP is shared across all GPUs using Distributed Data Parallel (DDP) to ensure consistent color prediction for novel views.
Appearance Embedding is shared across GPUs; set to zero during novel-view rendering if enabled during training.

The concept of decomposing NeRF representations for efficiency originated with [KiloNeRF](8942-kilonerf.md), which demonstrated that replacing a single large MLP with thousands of small MLPs could accelerate rendering by three orders of magnitude without sacrificing visual quality.
